package handlers

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/usecase"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
)

type Handler struct {
	summaries *usecase.LearningSessionSummaryService
}

func New(summaries *usecase.LearningSessionSummaryService) *Handler {
	return &Handler{summaries: summaries}
}

func (h *Handler) Health(c echo.Context) error {
	return c.JSON(http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ok"})
}

func (h *Handler) GetLearningSessionSummary(c echo.Context) error {
	studentID, studentErr := uuid.Parse(c.Param("student_id"))
	sessionID, sessionErr := uuid.Parse(c.Param("session_id"))
	if studentErr != nil || sessionErr != nil {
		return c.JSON(http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid identity"})
	}
	result, err := h.summaries.Get(c.Request().Context(), studentID, sessionID)
	if err != nil {
		return c.JSON(http.StatusInternalServerError, map[string]string{"error": "summary unavailable"})
	}
	return c.JSON(http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"summary": result})
}
